name: Nadia Rahman
summary: I harden what the team ships. I have broken into systems for a living before building them — so I think in threat models, not feature lists. On this capstone I own the security posture end to end: secrets, pipelines, access control, and the audit trail a regulated partner can actually sign off on.

artifacts.title: BASTION — Zero-Trust Access Layer
artifacts.description: Identity-aware proxy cutting lateral movement risk by 81% across a multi-service estate.

artifacts.title: SENTINEL-POLICY — IaC Guardrails
artifacts.description: Terraform policy pack blocking 140+ misconfigurations before deploy.

artifacts.title: AUDIT-TRAIL — Compliance Pipeline
artifacts.description: Tamper-evident logging pipeline mapped to SOC2 controls for a fintech pilot.

whyMe: Most student projects treat security as a week-eleven checklist. I treat it as a design constraint from day one — so the partner inherits a system they can put in front of their own security review without flinching. I bring the attacker's perspective so the team never ships a soft target.
